result_blind_statement: No R2 output existed when this file was frozen. All R1 outputs were visible to the designer; R2 endpoints that depend on R2 measurements are frozen as formulas, not values.

decisions.D1: EC group ristretto255 via the rbcl binding to libsodium, subject to a static supply-chain review before installation; if the review fails, a ctypes wrapper over libsodium (option B) with identical interfaces. The choice is recorded in the deviation log.
decisions.D2: Batched DLEQ verification is run as a secondary variant.
decisions.D3: ffdhe2048 and ffdhe3072 are retained as the like-for-like baseline, with the W11 hash and membership fixes.
decisions.D5: Primary testbed deadline is the frozen formula in R2_DEADLINE_TESTBED.primary_deadline.
decisions.D6: Paper adds the W1 theorem and Definition 7 uses PAC+.

R2_CORRECTNESS.label: UNIT_AND_INTEGRATION_TESTS
requirements: ristretto255 group: from_hash output is a valid non-identity element; scalar arithmetic modulo the group order
DLEQ completeness and rejection of altered responses in ristretto255
threshold KEM and TDH2 end-to-end open with t valid partials; failure with t-1
TDH2: re-submitted C1 under a new record id is rejected by custodians; malleated C1*g^gamma is rejected; invalid ciphertext proof is rejected
ffdhe hash_to_group: candidate expanded to ceil((bitlen(p)+128)/8) bytes with an XMD-style SHA-256 expander before reduction; output is a quadratic residue != 1
ffdhe membership test by Jacobi symbol agrees with x^q mod p == 1 on random and adversarial inputs
R2_CORRECTNESS.rule: All correctness tests pass before any R2 measurement runs.

R2_MICROBENCH.label: LOCAL_MICROBENCHMARK
R2_MICROBENCH.host: same host class as R1 (Apple M4 Pro); environment recorded per run
operations: DLEQ batch verification of t partials (secondary)
R2_MICROBENCH.repetitions: at least 1000 timed runs per operation after 50 warm-up runs; report median and 95th percentile

R2_DEADLINE_TESTBED.label: SINGLE_HOST_EMULATION_REAL_CRYPTO_NOT_FIELD_DATA
R2_DEADLINE_TESTBED.topology: 32 custodian OS processes, each an asyncio TCP server on 127.0.0.1 holding only its own share; one combiner process (asyncio client) that issues requests, verifies DLEQ proofs as responses arrive, stops at t valid, combines, unwraps the record key and AES-GCM-decrypts Proof verification runs off the combiner event loop (worker thread or process).
R2_DEADLINE_TESTBED.network_emulation: one-way delay per message drawn by the combiner-side emulator from the trace seed and passed as out-of-band emulation metadata; the custodian sleeps the inbound delay before computing and the outbound delay before replying; lost messages are never answered; no retransmission
R2_DEADLINE_TESTBED.delay_model: lognormal one-way delay with stated median and sigma (log-space); 0 means no injected delay

committee.keygen: dealer keygen once per profile run

R2_DEADLINE_TESTBED.crypto: ristretto255; dispute partials use TDH2 with label (epoch, record id, policy hash); audit uses beacon-derived canary
R2_DEADLINE_TESTBED.crash_selection: crashed members chosen uniformly per trace from the trace seed; domain outage = one domain chosen uniformly per trace, all 8 members silent

variants.SERIAL: primary: serial verification on arrival, stop at t valid
variants.BATCH: secondary: verify arrivals in batches by random linear combination; fall back to individual verification on batch failure

primary_deadline.formula: Delta_d_star(profile) = delta_b + c_p + delta_p99(profile) + t * c_v + c_c

terms.c_p: R2_MICROBENCH median of partial decryption + DLEQ proof (ristretto255)
terms.c_v: R2_MICROBENCH median of serial DLEQ verification (ristretto255)
terms.c_c: R2_MICROBENCH median of combine t partials plus TDH2 unwrap (ristretto255)
terms.delta_p99: 99th percentile of the profile's one-way delay law: median_ms * exp(2.3263 * sigma); 0 for D0-CONTROL

primary_deadline.procedure: computed after R2_MICROBENCH and before any testbed trace; written to r2-deadline-record.json and hashed; the same values apply to both variants

R2_DEADLINE_TESTBED.primary_endpoint: P[dispute decrypts the correct plaintext by Delta_d_star(profile)] per profile, SERIAL variant
secondary_endpoints: same endpoint for the BATCH variant
audit pass rate versus exact expectation
R2_DEADLINE_TESTBED.interval_method: Wilson 95% for proportions; order-statistic quantiles for times
R2_DEADLINE_TESTBED.pre_stated_expectation: near 100% success by Delta_d_star for reconstructable profiles; 0% for D5-GLOBAL-CRASH11; reported whatever the outcome
R2_DEADLINE_TESTBED.claim_boundary: single host, synthetic delay laws; no claim about geo-distributed deployment or ledger delay

R2_TEMPORAL_EXACT.label: EXACT_UNDER_DECLARED_SYNTHETIC_MODEL
R2_TEMPORAL_EXACT.model: non-selective faults; each custodian an independent two-state CTMC (failure rate lambda = 1/MTBF, repair rate mu = 1/MTTR); domain-shock variant: each of 4 domains of 8 additionally fails as a unit at rate 1/MTBF_domain and recovers at rate 1/MTTR_domain; audits every T with a fresh uniform sample (s, q) and acceptance probability from Theorem 1; dispute time independent of the process
R2_TEMPORAL_EXACT.method: K(t) birth-death chain with binomial-convolution transitions over T; forward (filtering) recursion over k in 0..32 with emission Pr[accept|k]; domain-shock variant uses the product chain over (domain states, k)
metrics: posterior Pr[K(tau) < t | all audits so far accepted], at the filter's fixed point, maximized over the dispute offset u in [0, T)
stationary Pr[K(tau) < t and the most recent audit before tau accepted], averaged over u uniform in [0, T)
design: largest T in the grid (and by bisection on a continuous T) meeting risk targets 1e-2, 1e-3, 1e-4 for each design
R2_TEMPORAL_EXACT.claim_boundary: synthetic parameters; real availability traces are future work

R2_TEMPORAL_SIM_CHECK.label: SIMULATION_IMPLEMENTATION_CHECK
R2_TEMPORAL_SIM_CHECK.cells: three grid cells: (MTBF 30 d, MTTR 6 h, T 6 h, (8,8)); (MTBF 7 d, MTTR 24 h, T 24 h, (16,14)); (MTBF 30 d, MTTR 6 h, T 6 h, (16,14), domain MTBF 90 d)
R2_TEMPORAL_SIM_CHECK.runs: 200000 audit intervals per cell after a burn-in of 10000 intervals
R2_TEMPORAL_SIM_CHECK.criterion: each simulated metric within its 99% Wilson interval of the exact value; any miss is investigated as an implementation error and logged

deviation_rule: Any change after the first R2 run is appended to research-case/03-design/r2-design-amendment/r2-deviation-log.md with time, reason and effect on claims; this file is not edited.
